title: PulseTags
description: Modern lightweight placeholder and tag system for Paper servers with fast performance and easy customization.
body:
# PulseTags

PulseTags is a modern lightweight placeholder and tag system built for Paper servers.

Designed as a clean and fast alternative to older placeholder plugins, PulseTags focuses on performance, simplicity, and developer-friendly customization.

## Features

- Lightweight and optimized
- Modern placeholder system
- Custom player tags
- Easy configuration
- Fast performance
- Paper support
- Simple API for developers
- Clean chat integration

## Example Placeholders

- %pulsetags_name%
- %pulsetags_rank%
- %pulsetags_prefix%

## Installation

1. Download the plugin jar
2. Put it in your `plugins` folder
3. Restart the server
4. Configure files if needed

## Compatibility

- Paper 1.21+
- Java 21

## Commands

- `/pulsetags reload`
- `/pulsetags info`

## Permissions

- `pulsetags.admin`
- `pulsetags.reload`

## Developer API

PulseTags is designed to be expandable and developer-friendly for future integrations.
